theme: 个股·分红送转：中国神华分红方案/股息率/除权除息与全市场分红排行
question: 换个话题，最近三年A股里累计现金分红最多的前五家公司是哪几家？
first_sql: SELECT s.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`, s.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票简称`, SUM(s.TOT_ACCUM_DIV) / 100000000 AS `最近三年累计现金分红(亿元)` FROM STK_DIV_STAT s JOIN GET_A_SEC_CODE c ON s.COMCODE = c.COMCODE AND c.ISVALID = 1 WHERE s.ISVALID = 1 AND s.DIV_YEAR >= 2023 AND s.DIV_YEAR <= 2025 AND s.TOT_ACCUM_DIV IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.A_STOCKCODE, s.A_STOCKSNAME ORDER BY `最近三年累计现金分红(亿元)` DESC LIMIT 5
final_sql: SELECT s.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`, s.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票简称`, SUM(s.TOT_ACCUM_DIV) / 100000000 AS `最近三年累计现金分红(亿元)` FROM STK_DIV_STAT s JOIN GET_A_SEC_CODE c ON s.COMCODE = c.COMCODE AND c.ISVALID = 1 WHERE s.ISVALID = 1 AND s.DIV_YEAR >= 2023 AND s.DIV_YEAR <= 2025 AND s.TOT_ACCUM_DIV IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.A_STOCKCODE, s.A_STOCKSNAME ORDER BY `最近三年累计现金分红(亿元)` DESC LIMIT 5
